description: Return upcoming regulatory deadlines across all tracked EU regulations within the next N days (default 365). Each result includes regulation shortName, date, event description, and Article reference. Sorted ascending by date.

within_days.description: Look-ahead window in days from today. Defaults to 365. Maximum 1825 (5 years).

name: upcoming_deadlines

outputSchema.description: Object with today, horizon, withinDays, count, and sorted array of deadlines (date, regulation, event, articleRef).
